name: Rhydderch Hael
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rhydderch Hael, also called Rhydderch the Generous, is an Arthurian hero. He owned a cauldron of abundance. Apart from that detail, legend says little about him.

okr.objective: Rhydderch Hael is an Arthurian hero who owned a cauldron.
